description: Maps an IPv4 address to its origin AS number, the BGP prefix that covers it, the country, the registry and the allocation date, using Team Cymru's public IP-to-ASN DNS service. Returns no origin when Cymru has no mapping for the address. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_cymru_asn_lookup
title: Security Cymru Asn Lookup
